_comment: FR-2 contested rendering. Two decisions on one subject are in an open contest; a non-contested insight on the same topic outranks the losing side, so the pair is split by ranking alone. Locks two things: both sides carry the [contested] marker, and groupContestedAdjacent pulls the pair back together (the needle '[contested]\nDecision [' only holds if a Decision — not the Insight — follows the contested line). Timestamps are excluded from every needle because the scenario clock is generation-time.
